title: Copy settings from one PIM Manager environment to another
purpose: Copies named PIM Manager settings (for example the naming conventions) from one environment's store to another environment's store: it reads both, shows the difference, backs up the target's current value, and only with -Apply overwrites it and reads it back.
whenToRun: When a new or rebuilt environment should start from settings that are already right in another environment (for example a managing tenant's naming conventions for a managed tenant). Settings that name the environment itself (who may use it, break-glass state, trust pins, store pointers, licence, environment name, demo mode) are refused.

runAs.name: Source store reader (application with a certificate, member of the source SQL admin group)
runAs.why: Reads the setting from the source store. The identity is given with -FromClientId / -FromCertThumbprint and its certificate must be in the local machine certificate store.

runAs.name: Target store writer (application with a certificate, member of the target SQL admin group)
runAs.why: Reads the target's current value and, with -Apply, writes the new one. Given with -ToClientId / -ToCertThumbprint.

changes.object: pim.Settings row for each -Name (one JSON document per setting)
changes.why: The point of the script: the target gets the source's value (with -MergeKeys, the source's top-level keys plus the keys only the target has).
changes.undo: Run the script again with -From and -To swapped, or import the TARGET-BEFORE backup file it wrote.

changes.why: The target's value before any change, so it can be restored; taken on every run, also a dry run.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.help: The setting(s) to copy, e.g. NamingConventions. There is no 'copy everything'.

parameters.name: FromClientId
parameters.help: Application (client) id of the identity that reads the source store.

parameters.name: FromCertThumbprint
parameters.help: Thumbprint of that identity's certificate in the local machine store.

parameters.name: ToClientId
parameters.help: Application (client) id of the identity that writes the target store.

parameters.name: ToCertThumbprint
parameters.help: Thumbprint of that identity's certificate in the local machine store.

parameters.name: BackupDir
parameters.help: Where the backups are written before anything changes.

parameters.name: MergeKeys
parameters.help: For an object setting: keep the top-level keys only the target has (the source's keys win). Arrays and plain values are replaced whole.

parameters.name: Apply
parameters.help: Write. Without it the script only shows what would change.

readsOnly: pim.Settings in the source store (the named settings)
pim.Settings in the target store (the named settings, before and after the write)
network: login.microsoftonline.com (tokens for Azure SQL, certificate sign-in)
whatIf: Reads both stores, prints the source and target values and 'What if: Performing the operation "overwrite with the source value" on target "pim.Settings['<Name>'] in <server>/<database> (tenant <id>)"'. Nothing is written to either store; a backup in the temp folder is still taken, a backup elsewhere is only announced.
undo: Run the same command with the From and To values swapped (it restores the previous environment's value), or write back the TARGET-BEFORE backup file. The local backups can be deleted.
